The test image shows coffee berries with notable dark/blackened blotchy discoloration on many of the red cherries. The disease affects the fruit (berries), not the leaves. Key features: dark blotches on red berries, some berries fully blackened.

This strongly suggests Berry_Blotch. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The Berry_Blotch reference shows leaf spots on young plants. However, the test image clearly shows coffee berries with dark blotchy discoloration — some berries are partially or fully blackened while others remain red. This is consistent with berry disease.

Among all 6 classes, "Berry_Blotch" is the only one that semantically and visually fits fruit/berry disease. The other classes (Rust, Cerscospora, Brown_Eye_Spot, Miner, Phoma) are primarily leaf diseases with distinct leaf-specific symptoms.
